items.title: More Dentists Are Referring to Endodontists, New AAE Survey Finds
items.summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE CHICAGO – A new survey from the American Association of Endodontists (AAE) reveals that referrals from general dentists continue to play a critical and growing role in endodontic care, underscoring the importance of specialist treatment in saving patients’ natural teeth —and the strong confidence general dentists have in endodontists as trusted partners in patient care.
